core.summary: Framework-independent schema, state, validation, conditions, dependencies, data sources, and lifecycle contracts.

react.summary: Headless React provider, hooks, subscriptions, and renderer extension points.

react-html.summary: Accessible browser-native React controls, layouts, styles, and form components.

html.summary: Compatibility entry point forwarding the React HTML surface; new applications should import React HTML directly.

symbols.core.FormSchema: Root declarative form contract. See the schema reference before accepting schemas across a trust boundary.
symbols.core.FieldSchema: Declarative field contract shared by supported renderers.
symbols.core.FormStore: Framework-neutral observable form state and mutation boundary.
symbols.core.createFormValidator: Creates the authoritative client-side validator for a schema; servers must still validate submitted data.
symbols.react.FormProvider: Owns the React form context, store lifecycle, validation mode, and optional submission callbacks.
symbols.react.useFormState: Subscribes to a selected form-state slice through React external-store semantics.
symbols.react.useField: Binds a field path to value, touched state, errors, and validation behavior.
symbols.react-html.HtmlForm: Renders a schema with native HTML controls and owns normal browser-form submission.
symbols.react-html.HtmlField: Renders one field through the React HTML registry.
symbols.html.HTML_ADAPTER_VERSION: Compatibility-package version marker; this does not identify a separate native DOM renderer.
